full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to this Rule are that C.R. plot No. 404 measuring -14 decimals and C.R. plot No. 400 measuring 13 decimals compressing a raiyati holding at a jama of Tk. 20/-recorded in Chakla Roshnabad Khatian No. 1 of mouza Bishuapur popularly known as Kaptan Bazar within Comilla municipality was originally owned by Munshi Torabuddin Kazi. On his death his heirs sold the entire holding to Hosna Balm by a register kabala dated 2. 6. 34  Ext. A(2). After her purchase Hosna Bairn raised residential construction in the holding. Thereafter she transferred the en-tire C.R. plot No. 404 to her daughter O.P. No. 2 Afia Khatun by a registered kabala dated 9.2.52. Ext. A (1) and delivered possession. She sold also the entire C.R. plot No. 400 to her son Abed Ali the pre-emptor by a registered kabala dated 29.4.54 Ext. 1. O.P. No. 2 Afia Khatun the sister of pre-emptor used to stay with her husband to a different place and therefore the pre-emptor alone used to posses the entire holding comprising of 27 decimals of land and he raised residential constructions in C.R. plot No. 404 the opposite No.2 instituted T.S. No. 62 of 1968 in the said court of Munsif against the petitioner with a prayer for ejectment of the petitioner from C.R. plot No. 404. The suit was decreed on compromise on the basis of a solenama Ext. E. on 21.6.69. In terms of the solenama the O.P. No. 2 would get recovery of 12 decimal of land of C.R. plot No. 404 and the petitioner would get '02 decimal of land in the eastern part of the said plot and he would remove the structures. It was further agreed by the parties in the solenama that O.P. 2 would execute a kabala in favour of the pre-emptor in respect of '02 decimals of case plot No. 404. It was stipulated that if the O. P. No. 2 failed to execute the kabala in respcot of the said '02 decimal of the land petitioner would get the same through court in a suit for specific performance of contract. In terms of the solenama the petitioner removed his structures from 12 decimal land in December, 1970 and continued in possession of '02 decimal of laud of the case plot No. 404. Since O.P. No. 2 did not execute a kabala in terms of the solenama the petitioner instituted T.S. No.91 of 1970 in the said court of Munsif for specific performance of contract against the O.P. No. 2 and got a decree on 29.11.72 but the decree was not pa into execution and he did not get any kabala through court. On 17.4.80 O.Ps. Nos. 1-2 asked the petitioner to remove his structures from the said -02 decimal land of case plot No. 404 in presence of witnesses and on that occasion O.P. No.2 disclosed for the first time that she had sold the case plot No. 404 comprising -14 decimals of land to opposite party No. 1 by a registered kabala. Before this date the petitioner had no knowledge of any such kabala. The petitioner procured certified copy of the kabala and learnt about the transfer in details on 19.7.80 that O.P.2 had sold tie entire case plot No. 404 to her daughter O.P. No. 1 by a kabala dated 5.3.75 at a consideration of Tk. 2500/- and the kabala was registered on 21.4.78 under section 60 of the Registration Act. No notice of the impugned transfer was given to the petitioner who is a co-sharer in the suit holding. Therefore, the petitioner filed an application for pre-emption on 7.8.80 under section 24 of the East Bengal Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act depositing statutory compensation along with consideration of the kabala.
